records.context: These are the raw-pixel definitions in Brieflow ``cp_emulator``. Otsu selects the first observed value maximising between-class variance, placing equal values in the lower class; a constant object has threshold 0. Integer thresholds equal :func:`mahotas.thresholding.otsu`; real images use the same observed-value rule without histogram binning. Colocalisation coefficients are 0.0 when either image data channel sums to zero; a slope is 0.0 when its predictor has zero variance. These replace undefined values with 0.0 so feature filtering retains the columns. Four image data channels give 54 columns per compartment, or 162 over cell, nucleus and cytoplasm. Pearson is supplied by the shared Funk block.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation_otsu#9
records.source: These are the raw-pixel definitions in Brieflow ``cp_emulator``. Otsu selects the first observed value maximising between-class variance, placing equal values in the lower class; a constant object has threshold 0. Integer thresholds equal :func:`mahotas.thresholding.otsu`; real images use the same observed-value rule without histogram binning. Colocalisation coefficients are 0.0 when either channel sums to zero; a slope is 0.0 when its predictor has zero variance. These replace undefined values with 0.0 so feature filtering retains the columns. Four channels give 54 columns per compartment, or 162 over cell, nucleus and cytoplasm. Pearson is supplied by the shared Funk block.
records.translation: Estas son las definiciones sobre píxeles brutos de ``cp_emulator`` de Brieflow. Otsu selecciona el primer valor observado que maximiza la varianza entre clases, situando los valores iguales al umbral en la clase inferior; un objeto constante tiene umbral 0. Los umbrales para valores enteros coinciden con :func:`mahotas.thresholding.otsu`; las imágenes de valores reales usan la misma regla de valores observados sin agruparlos en intervalos de histograma. Los coeficientes de colocalización son 0.0 cuando la suma de cualquiera de los canales es cero; una pendiente es 0.0 cuando su predictor tiene varianza cero. Estas reglas sustituyen los valores indefinidos por 0.0 para que el filtrado de características conserve las columnas. Cuatro canales producen 54 columnas por compartimento, o 162 entre célula, núcleo y citoplasma. El bloque Funk compartido proporciona la correlación de Pearson.
